test_dataframe_cov: test the DataFrame.cov() method for computing covariance matrices with min_periods and ddof parameters
test_dataframe_corr: test the DataFrame.corr() method for computing correlation matrices with pearson, spearman, and kendall methods
test_dataframe_corrwith: test the DataFrame.corrwith() method for computing correlations between a DataFrame and another Series or DataFrame
test_cov_numeric_only: test DataFrame.cov() with numeric_only=True to filter non-numeric columns before computing covariance
test_corr_nullable_integer: test DataFrame.corr() with nullable integer columns and scipy correlation methods
test_corr_min_periods: test DataFrame.corr() with min_periods parameter to control minimum observations required
test_corrwith_drop: test DataFrame.corrwith() with drop=True to exclude non-overlapping index or column labels
